g.text: Uno logical pin map: CS to Uno D8; MOSI to Uno D11; MISO to Uno D12; SCK to Uno D13; SS OUTPUT to Uno D10. J1 pin map: CS=D8, MOSI=D11, MISO=D12, SCK=D13; keep D10 configured as an output for SPI controller mode.

g.desc: Uno logical pin map: CS to Uno D8; MOSI to Uno D11; MISO to Uno D12; SCK to Uno D13; SS OUTPUT to Uno D10. J1 pin map: CS=D8, MOSI=D11, MISO=D12, SCK=D13; keep D10 configured as an output for SPI controller mode.

g.text: This is a signal map only. Use a breakout with documented regulation and safe 5 V logic translation. Never connect a bare microSD card directly to Uno 5 V signals. Physical card was not tested.
